final: WITH rating_prices AS (SELECT rating, AVG(1.0 * rental_rate / NULLIF(rental_duration, 0)) AS avg_price_per_day FROM film GROUP BY rating), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_price_per_day) AS across_rating_avg FROM rating_prices) SELECT AVG(r.avg_price_per_day) AS avg_price_per_day_above_average, AVG(r.avg_price_per_day - b.across_rating_avg) AS avg_amount_above_average FROM rating_prices AS r CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE r.avg_price_per_day > b.across_rating_avg
